# SSM Parameter Store

Store versioned parameters, labels, tags, and hierarchy queries.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ssm` |
| Signing name | `ssm` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2014-11-06` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 13 of 152 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

- String, StringList and SecureString parameter records.
- Get by name/path, history, labels and version-aware updates.
- Public EC2 image parameters supplied from the local catalogue.
- Customer-managed KMS key usability checks.

## Limitations and future work

- SecureString values are stored as plaintext; undecrypted reads return a placeholder.
- Only Parameter Store is implemented, not the broader Systems Manager API.
- No parameter policies, shared parameters, advanced data types or quotas.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
